verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs establish internal linking as a core feature: linking notes builds a network of knowledge, Wikilinks are the default syntax (they can be disabled in favor of Markdown links), and links update automatically when a file is renamed. Backlinks appear only indirectly, in one community user's template that pulls links and backlinks into context, and nothing in the pack covers unlinked mentions or viewing either in context. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a backlinks pane showing linking context, any evidence of unlinked-mention detection, independent hands-on corroboration of backlink/mention workflows
